name: faf001_AssignTask
description: Assign an eligible unassigned open task to the caller using optimistic concurrency. First successful claim wins. Does not change record ownership.

CustomAPIRequestParameters.name: faf001_AssignTask.faf001_TaskId
CustomAPIRequestParameters.description: Required nonempty task GUID. Assignee is always the Dataverse caller.

CustomAPIResponseProperties.name: faf001_AssignTask.faf001_TaskId
CustomAPIResponseProperties.description: Claimed task GUID. Repeated claim by its current assignee does not modify the task.
